title: Seven Winters and One Short Line
subtitle: 课堂教学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 课堂教学（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：课堂教学（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：example　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 example 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my teacher ① gave an example that no pupil in the class would have repeated, and he said the giving was the whole of the winter. The ② example, meaning the case itself and not the rule, ran seven winters and stayed unrepeated in the book; an example, he said, is the only thing in a class that is judged by how long it is left unrepeated.

Every ③ example in that class had the same short line beside it, and the ④ example at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An example, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to repeat; my teacher said the repeating is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the example was the whole of the lesson, meaning the model and not the case. The ⑥ example, meaning the model and not any of that, is the only thing in a lesson that everybody waits for and nobody repeats; example, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a case and a model. He said the model is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ example had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short line. The ⑧ example of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in January, was one class and seven winters of repeating; example, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to repeat. He said the repeating was never mentioned.

The ⑨ example I remember is the one repeated in the notebook, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the class. An ⑩ example, my mother said in 1973, is the only one that improves by being repeated; every example, she said, is a model that has agreed to look like a case. She said the model was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 例子；实例（指班上每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 例子（指那一个实例本身，与规则相对）
C. 固定搭配：give an example 举一个例子
D. n. 例子（指留给考试的那一个）
E. n. 例子（抽象总称，指一个班上的举例之事）
F. n. 例子（指笔记本上写到、被复述的那一个）
G. n. 榜样；范例（指一堂课里人人都等却无人复述的那样东西）
H. n. 范例（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人复述的那样东西）

items.q: gave an example that no pupil in the class would have repeated
The example, meaning the case itself and not the rule
the example at the far side

The example of the whole thing
An example, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: give an example 意为“举一个例子”，1961 年老师举了一个班上没有一个学生肯复述的例子。
example 意为“例子”，指那一个实例本身而不是规则，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
example 意为“例子”，指班上每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一行短短的字。
example 意为“例子”，指留给考试的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
example 意为“榜样、范例”，指一堂课里人人都等却无人复述的那样东西，叔叔说这个范例就是那堂课的全部。
example 意为“范例”，指人人都等却无人复述的那样东西而不是那一个实例，是课堂上人人都等、却无人复述的东西。
example 意为“例子”，指笔记本上写到、被复述的那一个，到 1968 年这一个成了笔记本里的一行。
example 意为“例子”，老师一月写道，整件事的举例之事是一个班级和七个冬天的复述。
example 意为“例子”，我记得的是笔记本上复述的那一个，1971 年结束了，至今仍被说成班上最安静的一个。
example 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，一个例子是唯一会因为被好好复述而变得更好的东西。
